title: Confirm Pre Bag Out scope: exchange the lowest 25% of destinations per sorter leg
summary: Use the UPSFORTNA OptiSweep bag out control UI to confirm that “Pre bag out” is configured to exchange the lowest 25% of destinations per sorter leg (not all destinations).
when_to_use: Use when you are running bag out and need to ensure the “Pre bag out” exchange scope is limited to the lowest 25% of destinations per sorter leg.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Select the “pre bag out” option in the bag out control UI and verify the scope applies per sorter leg.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the bag out control UI that includes “pre bag out”
UI/status visibility for destination subset and sorter leg scope

access_required: Operator access to the bag out control UI
system_preconditions: Bag out control UI is available and showing the bag out options (including “pre bag out”).

visual_references.description: Overall System Bag Out Control UI area showing the “Pre bag out exchanges the lowest 25% of destinations per leg of the sorter” rule.

steps.title: Locate the “pre bag out” option in the bag out control area
steps.purpose: Find the control that enables the pre-bag-out exchange scope.
steps.instruction: In the Overall System Bag Out Control UI, locate the “Pre bag out” option within the bag out control area.
steps.expected_result: The “Pre bag out” option is visible in the bag out control UI.
steps.healthy_condition: The bag out control UI shows “Pre bag out” as an available option.
steps.failure_condition: The bag out control UI does not show a “Pre bag out” option.

actions.label: Find pre bag out option
actions.exact_action: Locate the “pre bag out” option in the bag out control area.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the UI does not support a “pre bag out” option.

source_evidence.quote: Pre bag out exchanges the lowest 25% of destinations per leg of the sorter.

steps.title: Select “pre bag out” and confirm the scope is lowest 25% per sorter leg
steps.purpose: Ensure the pre-bag-out exchange scope is limited to the lowest 25% of destinations per leg.
steps.instruction: Select “Pre bag out” in the Overall System Bag Out Control UI and confirm the scope corresponds to “the lowest 25% of destinations per leg of the sorter.”
steps.expected_result: The selected bag out mode indicates “Pre bag out” with the lowest 25% per leg scope.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI reflects that pre bag out exchanges the lowest 25% of destinations per leg of the sorter (not all destinations).
steps.failure_condition: The UI does not reflect the “lowest 25% per leg” scope, or appears to include all destinations.

actions.label: Select pre bag out
actions.exact_action: Select “pre bag out” and ensure the scope is set to “exchange the lowest 25% of destinations per leg of the sorter.”

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the UI does not reflect the “lowest 25% per leg” scope described by the source.

source_evidence.quote: Pre bag out exchanges the lowest 25% of destinations per leg of the sorter.
Pre bag out exchanges the lowest 20 percent, 25% of the destinations per leg of the sorter.

steps.title: Verify sorter leg selection (if applicable) so the lowest 25% rule applies per selected leg(s)
steps.purpose: Confirm the pre-bag-out scope is applied per the intended sorter leg selection.
steps.instruction: If the bag out control UI allows selecting a sorter leg, verify the leg selection so the “lowest 25% of destinations per leg of the sorter” rule applies to the selected leg(s).
steps.expected_result: The sorter leg selection (if present) is set such that the lowest-25% rule applies per the selected leg(s).
steps.healthy_condition: The UI indicates pre bag out is constrained per leg selection (not a single global subset).
steps.failure_condition: The UI scope appears not to be applied per the selected leg(s), or the selection causes the rule to apply incorrectly.

actions.label: Check sorter leg selection
actions.exact_action: Verify the sorter leg selection (if applicable) so the “lowest 25%” rule applies per the selected leg(s).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the exchange tasks appear to include destinations outside the lowest 25% subset per leg.

source_evidence.quote: Pre bag out exchanges the lowest 25% of destinations per leg of the sorter.

steps.title: Observe exchange tasks correspond to the lowest 25% destination subset per leg
steps.purpose: Validate that the configured pre-bag-out scope is actually reflected in the resulting exchange tasks.
steps.instruction: After selecting “Pre bag out,” observe the exchange tasks (or the UI status that lists included destinations) and confirm they correspond only to the lowest 25% destination subset per sorter leg.
steps.expected_result: The exchange tasks/destination list includes only destinations within the lowest 25% subset per leg.
steps.healthy_condition: Destinations included in the exchange are limited to the lowest 25% per leg (not all destinations).
steps.failure_condition: Exchange tasks include destinations outside the lowest 25% subset per leg.

actions.label: Check included destinations for exchange
actions.exact_action: Observe that the exchange tasks correspond to the lowest 25% destination subset per leg as described by the source.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the exchange tasks appear to include destinations outside the lowest 25% subset per leg.

source_evidence.quote: Pre bag out exchanges the lowest 25% of destinations per leg of the sorter.

success_criteria: “Pre bag out” is selected in the Overall System Bag Out Control UI.
The UI reflects that pre bag out exchanges the lowest 25% of destinations per sorter leg.
The resulting exchange tasks/destination subset correspond only to that lowest-25% per-leg scope.
healthy_conditions: Bag out control UI shows “Pre bag out” and indicates the lowest 25% per leg scope.
Exchange tasks/destination list are limited to the lowest 25% subset per leg.
failure_conditions: No “Pre bag out” option exists in the bag out control UI.
UI does not reflect the lowest 25% per leg scope.
Exchange tasks include destinations outside the lowest 25% subset per leg.
escalation_guidance: If the UI does not support “pre bag out,” or if the UI/scope does not match “lowest 25% per leg,” stop the operation and escalate.
